title: API N+1 query storm
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the API component, the inefficient logic introduced in version 2.3.2 (the deploy), and the resulting DB overload as the cause.
root_cause: The API version 2.3.2 introduced inefficient logic for the /api/products endpoint, causing each request to take 2.8‑3.3 seconds and driving high DB CPU usage.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced an N+1 query pattern in the product listing: it fetches products with one query, then issues a separate query for each product's category and stock, overwhelming the database with thousands of tiny queries per page load.
